items_all.title: AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds
items_all.summary: Teams of AI agents barely outperform solo agents but cost up to 5.1x more, according to Vals AI. Only one out of four tests with GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 showed a measurable gain. Anthropic's own data backs this up: beyond ten agents, quality plateaus while token costs keep climbing. The article AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 Vals AI 的研究，AI 代理團隊的表現僅僅稍微優於單一代理，但成本卻高出最多 5.1 倍。在使用 GPT-6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 進行的四項測試中，只有一項顯示出可測量的增長。Anthropic's 自己的數據也支持這一點：在超過十個代理之後，品質會進入高原期，而權杖（token）成本則持續攀升。「AI 代理團隊浪費大量權杖，卻僅換取微乎其微的品質提升，研究發現」一文首先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds
items_all.summary: Epoch AI and Anthropic independently found the same thing: current AI models like GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5 can run experiments but lack scientific self-criticism and genuine creative thinking. At best, Sol reached 15 percent of the human reference score, and even that came from methods researchers already knew. The models' biggest weakness is still their inability to critically question their own results. The article AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Epoch AI 與 Anthropic 獨立發現了相同的結論：目前的 AI 模型（如 GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Claude Fable 5）能夠執行實驗，但缺乏科學的自我批判與真正的創造性思考。充其量，Sol 只達到人類基準分數的 15%，且這還是透過研究人員已知的方法達成的。這些模型最大的弱點依然是無法對自己的結果進行批判性提問。文章〈研究發現：AI 代理誇大其結果，距離自主研究仍相去甚遠〉（AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds）最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario
items_all.summary: Data from a16z shows a Jevons paradox in the AI market: token prices keep falling, but H100 GPU rental prices hold steady or climb. Cheaper AI drives demand faster than costs drop. If that demand flattens, the chain from chip makers to cloud providers takes a hit. The article Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: a16z 的數據顯示，AI 市場中存在傑文斯悖論（Jevons paradox）：權杖（token）價格持續下跌，但 H100 GPU 租賃價格保持穩定或攀升。更便宜的 AI 推動需求的成長速度大於成本下降的速度。如果這種需求趨於平穩，從晶片製造商到雲端服務供應商的整個產業鏈將受到衝擊。「更便宜的 AI 權杖正推動更多需求，而這正是黃仁勳的最佳劇本」一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server
items_all.summary: Starting October 2026, arXiv will cap submissions at two per person per month. Monthly submissions have doubled in two years, and in the cs.AI category they've grown more than sixfold. According to arXiv, a small fraction of authors are flooding the platform with low-quality papers, overwhelming its volunteer moderators. The article ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 從 2026 年 10 月開始，arXiv 將限制每人每月最多提交兩篇論文。每月提交量在兩年內翻了一倍，而在 cs.AI 分類中更是成長了六倍以上。根據 arXiv 的說法，極少數的作者正以低品質論文灌爆該平臺，讓其志工審查員應接不暇。本文「ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free
items_all.summary: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview. The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V. Odyssey claims top scores on physics benchmarks, though the methodology behind those results has limits. The article Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Odyssey 正在將其世界模型 Odyssey-3 以公開研究預覽的形式推出。這個擁有 140 億個參數的模型能從文字提示詞即時生成互動式環境，據報導還能控制機器人、無人機，甚至《GTA V》。Odyssey 宣稱其在物理基準測試中獲得最高分，儘管這些結果背後的方法論存在侷限性。這篇「Odyssey-3 是一個你可以免費試用的全新生成式世界模型」文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text
items_all.summary: Cloudflare released Clef-omni, an Apache-2.0 multimodal decision model built on Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B. items_all_raw.title: AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds
items_all_raw.summary: Teams of AI agents barely outperform solo agents but cost up to 5.1x more, according to Vals AI. Only one out of four tests with GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 showed a measurable gain. Anthropic's own data backs this up: beyond ten agents, quality plateaus while token costs keep climbing. The article AI agent teams waste massive tokens for barely measurable quality gains, research finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據 Vals AI 的研究，AI 代理團隊的表現僅僅稍微優於單一代理，但成本卻高出最多 5.1 倍。在使用 GPT-6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 進行的四項測試中，只有一項顯示出可測量的增長。Anthropic's 自己的數據也支持這一點：在超過十個代理之後，品質會進入高原期，而權杖（token）成本則持續攀升。「AI 代理團隊浪費大量權杖，卻僅換取微乎其微的品質提升，研究發現」一文首先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: Epoch AI and Anthropic independently found the same thing: current AI models like GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5 can run experiments but lack scientific self-criticism and genuine creative thinking. At best, Sol reached 15 percent of the human reference score, and even that came from methods researchers already knew. The models' biggest weakness is still their inability to critically question their own results. The article AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Epoch AI 與 Anthropic 獨立發現了相同的結論：目前的 AI 模型（如 GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Claude Fable 5）能夠執行實驗，但缺乏科學的自我批判與真正的創造性思考。充其量，Sol 只達到人類基準分數的 15%，且這還是透過研究人員已知的方法達成的。這些模型最大的弱點依然是無法對自己的結果進行批判性提問。文章〈研究發現：AI 代理誇大其結果，距離自主研究仍相去甚遠〉（AI agents overstate their results and remain far from autonomous research, study finds）最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario
items_all_raw.summary: Data from a16z shows a Jevons paradox in the AI market: token prices keep falling, but H100 GPU rental prices hold steady or climb. Cheaper AI drives demand faster than costs drop. If that demand flattens, the chain from chip makers to cloud providers takes a hit. The article Cheaper AI tokens are driving more demand, and that's Jensen Huang's best-case scenario appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: a16z 的數據顯示，AI 市場中存在傑文斯悖論（Jevons paradox）：權杖（token）價格持續下跌，但 H100 GPU 租賃價格保持穩定或攀升。更便宜的 AI 推動需求的成長速度大於成本下降的速度。如果這種需求趨於平穩，從晶片製造商到雲端服務供應商的整個產業鏈將受到衝擊。「更便宜的 AI 權杖正推動更多需求，而這正是黃仁勳的最佳劇本」一文最先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server
items_all_raw.summary: Starting October 2026, arXiv will cap submissions at two per person per month. Monthly submissions have doubled in two years, and in the cs.AI category they've grown more than sixfold. According to arXiv, a small fraction of authors are flooding the platform with low-quality papers, overwhelming its volunteer moderators. The article ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 從 2026 年 10 月開始，arXiv 將限制每人每月最多提交兩篇論文。每月提交量在兩年內翻了一倍，而在 cs.AI 分類中更是成長了六倍以上。根據 arXiv 的說法，極少數的作者正以低品質論文灌爆該平臺，讓其志工審查員應接不暇。本文「ArXiv caps submissions at two per month as AI paper flood overwhelms the preprint server」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview. The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V. Odyssey claims top scores on physics benchmarks, though the methodology behind those results has limits. The article Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Odyssey 正在將其世界模型 Odyssey-3 以公開研究預覽的形式推出。這個擁有 140 億個參數的模型能從文字提示詞即時生成互動式環境，據報導還能控制機器人、無人機，甚至《GTA V》。Odyssey 宣稱其在物理基準測試中獲得最高分，儘管這些結果背後的方法論存在侷限性。這篇「Odyssey-3 是一個你可以免費試用的全新生成式世界模型」文章最初發表於 The Decoder。
